datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Malawi on a monthly basis (January, April, July, October 2015) and spatially encoded as geographic features with classification scales and scenarios to represent acute food insecurity phases and their geographic distribution.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity status across geographic areas.
